title: SCORE: Environment 1
why: Environment 1's demo film (the owner's script of 2026-10-21): the app's own steps in its own windows, then one unbroken shot from the Solar System down into the Base's rooms, then on through the whole environment (owner, 2026-10-21: "its needs to show all of env 1 ; so also earth and mars"): over the Moon's ground to the Wreck and the Old station, out to orbit and across to Earth's Square and its scenes, then to Mars's Campgrounds and its camp, each with its concept in the corner, every zoom followed by a walk through its scene and every scene it holds, parent before child (owner, 2026-10-24: "at the end it has scale zoom after scale zoom and no walkthroughs in between"; the default film, completed 2026-10-21: every segment names its scene, the physics animation 12 s so Earth goes nearly once round the Sun). The scale zooms and walk-throughs wait on what is not made yet (see each one's `waiting`): the preview shows what exists in their place.

segments.why: The hub's own loop as it happened (2026-10-20): a first draw, a second, a redraw with the creator's note, then the draw he picked. The hub is picked, so its page shows the history only: the note is said in the caption, not typed again (typing it would need an unlocked place; Redraw itself spends and is never clicked).

segments.waiting: the Base's scene inventory (no reading by today's method yet: confirmed objects outlined, skipped ones faint) and its architectural plan with its section (the plan review, made once the inventory counts). Until the readings and plans are made, this take shows the inventory waiting and the environment plan's Moon map with the Base's own plan at its site.

segments.waiting: the finished Base and its finished rooms (the remake's batch): until then the site and place legs show the masses of its plan and the room leg the rooms' picked concepts. In the final the place and room legs are film frames of the finished places.
